# Nigeria flood — `nga-flooding`

This is the endorsed 2026 revision of Nigeria's flood anticipatory action framework, focused on **Adamawa state** along the Benue river. The action trigger is a **multi-gauge consensus design**: fires when ≥6 of 10 selected Google GRRR gauges simultaneously exceed their individual 4-year return-period threshold, replacing the 2025 single-station OR logic (GloFAS OR GRRR at one Wuroboki gauge). A **GloFAS readiness trigger** (ensemble reforecast mean > 3,132 m³/s at Wuroboki, lead time ≤13 days) gives partners advance notice ahead of the action trigger, **OR**-ed with a GloFAS reanalysis safety-net branch — this OR-branch, previously only in the (unpublished) framework document while the repo analysis recommended against it, is now implemented in code. The **NHF flash-flood** component (observational, BAY states) is retargeted for 2026 to 4 LGAs (Mobbar, Maiduguri, Jere, Geidam — NiHSA composite score) with new per-LGA FloodScan-exposure thresholds from the framework document, validated against the operational data (equal per-LGA probability, combined ~3.5-yr RP). Email dispatch now runs through **Listmonk/ocha-relay** rather than raw SMTP. No funding envelope, implementing agencies, or target population are recorded (the framework document is pending publication). As of **2026-08-10/11 the full 2026 design is merged to `main` and live**: `monitoring.yml` (riverine) runs daily at 20:00 UTC and `flash-monitoring.yml` runs daily at 01:30 UTC (timed to the floodexposure chain), both with `STAGE=prod`; each stream's production audience is deliberately limited to two team members (soak test) pending migration of the full distribution list.

**Current version:** [2026-06-18](2026-06-18.md) · status: **endorsed** · repo `ocha-dap/ds-aa-nga-flooding`
